title: Official records, public claims and their limits
shared: These views help readers move from a speech, release or source collection to the exact record behind a claim. Some compare release methods; others provide a dated corpus or a close reading of one event.
keep_distinct: Keep statements, testimony, agency conclusions, legal effect, independent corroboration, causal claims and adjudication separate. Similar release methods do not establish shared actors, causes or outcomes across the subjects.
